name: spike-c-seed
description: Standalone seed script for Spike C (full-shell OpenHands adapter). Not part of the AtherNull pnpm workspace - own deps, run with its own npm install. Seeds one real org/project/task/execution/events into the local dev Postgres (infrastructure/docker-compose.yml's athernull_dev) through apps/api's real HTTP + internal endpoints, the same zero-cost pattern apps/api/test/job-lifecycle.test.ts uses.
